verdict.rationale: The evidence shows mail is scanned to PDFs and kept in free unlimited online storage that users can view from any device. Nothing documents a bulk export of scans or mail-history metadata, an archive download, or an API for pulling data off the platform; the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Viewing individual scans is not the same as bulk export, so this applicable axis gets no credit.

support.subject: As an operator, I can export my scans and mail history in bulk — PDFs and metadata leave the platform when I do
